name: Single scenario harness build
description: Validate that the skill defines a fixed scenario, keeps research normalized, creates a runnable fixture and charter, and produces score/report artifacts instead of stopping at a prompt.
prompt: Create a new UI testing scenario for an event discovery webapp. Use one clear Foundry style direction, one supporting motif, and one layout pattern. Build a runnable local fixture, write the Playwright charter, record the prompt trace, and produce a scorecard that calls out any Foundry gaps.

assertions.description: Must lock the scenario structure instead of leaving the request as an open-ended design prompt.
Must keep outside references as normalized research or dataset inputs rather than raw external prompt text.
Must build a runnable local surface with a real interaction state.
Must produce a deterministic Playwright QA charter for the fixture.
Must produce review artifacts and convert repeated issues into Foundry gaps.

name: Batch harness review and gap synthesis
description: Validate that the skill can review multiple scenarios as a system, score repeated anti-slop failures, and update the consolidated gap report without confusing sample-app bugs for Foundry workflow gaps.
prompt: Review a five-scenario web UI harness for Foundry. Compare the scenarios, identify repeated failures in style drift, responsive behavior, provenance, and testability, then write the consolidated report and update the master Foundry gaps doc with only the systemic issues.

assertions.description: Must treat the work as a comparative harness review rather than five isolated notes.
Must explicitly review style drift and generic output as first-class failure modes.
Must score responsive behavior beyond simple scaling.
Must include provenance and traceability in the scoring logic.
Must synthesize repeated issues into systemic Foundry gaps with clear ownership and fixes.
